recommendations.issue: Inconsistent kitchen execution and poorly prepared dishes during peak hours
recommendations.action: Implement standardized recipe cards at every kitchen station, conduct mandatory retraining on core menu items, and institute a strict expediter quality-check protocol before any plate leaves the kitchen.
recommendations.expected_impact: Reduction in food quality complaints and higher consistency across all service shifts.

recommendations.issue: Rude, inattentive, or unprofessional staff attitude driven by high stress and understaffing
recommendations.action: Launch a bi-weekly hospitality training workshop focused on de-escalation and customer service, adjust shift scheduling to ensure adequate floor coverage, and introduce a staff incentive program for positive customer mentions.
recommendations.expected_impact: Improved staff morale, more attentive customer interactions, and a noticeable drop in negative reviews regarding service attitude.

recommendations.issue: Long wait times for seating, service, and food delivery caused by operational bottlenecks
recommendations.action: Adopt a digital table management system to streamline host-stand seating flows and re-evaluate kitchen station workflows to eliminate bottlenecks between prep and line cook roles.
recommendations.expected_impact: Decreased table turnover times, faster overall ticket times, and improved customer satisfaction with wait management.

recommendations.issue: Customer dissatisfaction with high prices relative to perceived portion size or quality
recommendations.action: Audit top-tier menu items to ensure portion sizes align with current price points, or introduce bundled value combos to enhance the customer's perceived value.
recommendations.expected_impact: Better alignment between guest expectations and pricing, leading to fewer value-related complaints.

recommendations.issue: Lapses in restaurant cleanliness and hygiene due to a lack of structured schedules
recommendations.action: Create mandatory opening, mid-shift, and closing cleaning checklists with mandatory manager sign-offs for both front-of-house and back-of-house areas.
recommendations.expected_impact: Consistently spotless dining and restroom areas, ensuring full health compliance and elevated customer trust.
